findings.title: Normalize export vocabulary
findings.why_it_matters: Both terms denote the same URL; uniform wording would be neater.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace export URL with download link.
evidence: The terms "download link" and "export URL" both refer to the same signed URL.

residual_risks: The terminology might concern a future reader who prefers a single synonym, despite the explicit equivalence.
deferred_questions: Should this plan include a provider class hierarchy for hypothetical future signing providers?

findings.title: Use one link term
findings.why_it_matters: The wording varies but the reader is told it means the same thing.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace export URL with download link.
evidence: The terms "download link" and "export URL" both refer to the same signed URL.

findings.title: U2 omits ownership
findings.why_it_matters: U2 can sign another account’s export if implemented as stated.
findings.suggested_fix: Specify assertOwner before signing in U2.
evidence: U2 adds the download endpoint. It loads an export by its identifier and signs a link.

findings.title: Keep U2 as written
findings.why_it_matters: The URL signature already supplies ownership protection, so an ownership helper would be redundant.
findings.suggested_fix: Keep U2 without an ownership check.
evidence: A signed link does not replace the ownership check.

findings.why_it_matters: The deletion behavior differs between the two viable periods.
